claim_boundary: Twenty-three elite fencers extracted from a 1,280-row German sport/control survey. These are anonymous cross-sectional self-reports, not clinical diagnoses or injury onset labels. All 23 report lifetime back pain, so this subset cannot train an ever-injured versus never-injured classifier. Weapon is absent. Exact age, height, weight, and sport-experience years are removed or coarsened; BMI, training volume, cadre, regional pain periods, and intensity remain for local grouped analysis.
